Here's a plan that works inside T1 instead: 1) Ya Kun Kaya Toast (~15 min, before immigration): kopi C and soft-boiled eggs with kaya toast, so have it before you clear immigration. 2) Rooftop Cactus Garden (~10 min): quiet fresh air with over 100 cactus species, a nice stretch of the legs. That leaves roughly 55 minutes of cushion, and you'll want to keep the 15 minute gate buffer at the end, so head to your gate in good time.
